notes:
Pass on the fake backend (gate exit 0): evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wB1-005) and unreviewed; nothing ran on hardware. The card's entry symbol modules.comunication_client:Client was confirmed at modules/comunication_client.py:10. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: a direct Driver over Client instead of SerialDriver, and cap.sensing.read.v1 instead of the suggested cap.device.configure.v1. The upstream has only five read requests (STA, TYP, VOL, TMP, CUR) and no write or set command, so a configure class cannot bind; the SerialDriver command table cannot express the e-stop because the clone has no stop command. The e-stop closes Client.ser and sets it to None; Client.write_request writes through self.ser, so no further request can be sent. This is a software stop path at R1, not an independent hardware e-stop; none is claimed. No Limits: there is no numeric write or invoke input. The demo thresholds (80 degrees, 190 V, 25/800 mA) are application checks cited as Facts, not device limits. G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is the expected warning: there is no actuating binding with a limit, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe. The card's mock_strategy is upstream-sim, but the clone's Instrument is the device-side simulator and imports pyserial; importing or running clone code is forbidden here, so the package fake stands in for the transport. The fake's five replies are placeholder test data; the real Instrument generates a new random value per request, and the fake keeps its in-memory replies after the e-stop so the runtime can read the state for a receipt (a real pyserial port would refuse further I/O). Voltage is V and current is mA as the README states; temperature is unitless because the upstream names no scale. All five channels are scalar; no array is omitted. native.py opens the port and returns Client for hardware; it was never imported or run by this work, and the hardware factory defaults to the clone's example 9600 baud and 2 s timeout but accepts overrides. The loader refuses the hardware backend of an unreviewed model-written package only at R2 and R3, so this R1 package is not protected by that rule; use its hardware backend only with a person at the device. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. The DEVIATION FROM THE CARD is accepted: a registry override now makes the card a direct driver. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
